run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T00:00:53Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert tracks a real deviation: frontend's own error-tagged span series were 0 for every sampled step from 22:00Z to 00:00Z and then rose to a 5-minute rate of 0.84/s, with the failing operations being GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data and the client call grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (plus a small tcp.connect error rate); frontend-proxy's ingress and router frontend egress spans errored in the same minutes. The only dependency that stopped working is ad: Deployment ad carries a kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt annotation of 2026-11-17T23:59:42Z, a new ReplicaSet ad-d89765fb5 replaced ad-554b849958, and the replacement pod ad-d89765fb5-whfnz spent its first ~7 minutes pinned to its 50m CPU limit (0.0488-0.0497 cores, ~10 CFS throttled periods/s, JVM CPU ratio 0.98) while its only log line 'Ad service starting.' appeared at 00:03:55Z and ad's own oteldemo.AdService/GetAds server spans were absent from 00:02 to 00:09; frontend's GetAds errors start ~00:01 and stop ~00:08. ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config holds the ad-service fault switches: adManualGc is 'on' ('Triggers full manual garbage collections in the ad service') while adFailure and adHighCpu are 'off'. Hypothesis: that enabled ad fault, exercised by the freshly restarted pod, drove the sustained GC/CPU saturation that kept ad from serving and produced frontend's errors; an alternative hypothesis is that the restart plus the 50m CPU limit starved JVM startup for ~8 minutes. Counter-evidence for the flag hypothesis is that the pre-restart ad pod ran normally with the same ConfigMap and that the new pod's CPU returned to ~0.009 cores once serving resumed while the flag still reads 'on'. Nothing observed shows who or what applied the restart, and no trace-level error detail exists for 00:00-00:09 (Jaeger's newest trace is 23:57), so the fault mechanism and the trigger remain unconfirmed; conclusion is partial.

claims.text: frontend's error span series traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} was 0 at every 5-minute step from 22:00Z to 00:00:59Z, then 0.1185/s at 00:01, 0.5481/s at 00:03, peaked at 0.8407/s at 00:05 and was back to 0 by 00:12; the operations carrying errors were GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and tcp.connect, while GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder stayed at 0.

frontend's 2-minute error rate went 0 until 00:00, 1.50/s at 00:01, 2.60/s at 00:02-00:03, 2.58/s at 00:04, peaked 3.57/s at 00:05, 2.48/s at 00:06, 2.64/s at 00:07, 2.09/s at 00:08 and 0 from 00:09 onward, so the alert value 2.3556 at 00:00:53Z coincides with the start of this burst.

frontend-proxy's own error spans rose on operations "ingress" and "router frontend egress" (0.667/s and 0.656/s at 00:02, 0.883/s at 00:05, 0.522/s at 00:08, 0.189/s on ingress and 0 on egress at 00:09, 0 by 00:11), i.e. the proxy saw the frontend's failures on its egress to frontend.

Deployment ad in namespace otel-demo has pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T23:59:42Z, metadata.generation 2 and deployment.kubernetes.io/revision 2, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad (same repository/tag as before the rollout, container spec otherwise unchanged: AD_PORT 8080, FLAGD_HOST flagd, CPU limit 50m, memory limit 450Mi), and it defines no readinessProbe, livenessProbe or startupProbe.

Rollout events at 23:59:42-23:59:45Z: Deployment ad "Scaled up replica set ad-d89765fb5 from 0 to 1", ReplicaSet ad-d89765fb5 "Created pod: ad-d89765fb5-whfnz", that pod Scheduled 23:59:42, container Created 23:59:43, Started 23:59:44, and ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 "Deleted pod: ad-554b849958-gcmfq" with pod event "Stopping container ad" at 23:59:45 and Deployment ad "Scaled down replica set ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0".

ReplicaSet ownership: ad-554b849958 (owner Deployment ad) was created 2026-11-17T23:27:15Z and now has 0 replicas, ad-d89765fb5 (owner Deployment ad) was created 2026-11-17T23:59:42Z and has 1 replica; only ad and flagd have a superseded ReplicaSet in otel-demo.

Pod ad-d89765fb5-whfnz is Running and Ready with restartCount 0 and status.startTime 2026-11-17T23:59:42Z, and in the 23:55-00:22Z window its ad container produced exactly one log line, "Ad service starting.", stamped 2026-11-18T00:03:55.903Z; the container has no previous instance.

The ad service's own span activity stopped: oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) was ~0.49-0.71/s up to 00:00, 0.32/s at 00:01, then 0 at every step from 00:02 through 00:09, and 0.656/s at 00:10 and 0.556-0.757/s afterwards; internal spans getAdsByCategory and getRandomAds show the identical gap.

The replacement ad container was pinned to its CPU limit: rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container="ad"}) for pod ad-d89765fb5-whfnz was 0.0064 cores at 00:00, 0.0308 at 00:01, 0.0488-0.0497 from 00:02 to 00:07 (limit is 50m), 0.0285 at 00:08, 0.0096 at 00:10; the previous pod ad-554b849958-gcmfq ran at 0.0038-0.0080 cores, and rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total) was ~9.98-10.0 throttled periods/s for the new pod from 00:02 to 00:07 versus 0.14-0.94 for the old pod.

JVM CPU utilization of ad's new instance (exported_instance 5136db1b-6fe7-41be-931a-fbf09dc45c94) was 0.979 at 00:04, 0.986 at 00:05, 0.985 at 00:06, 0.967 at 00:07, 0.815 at 00:08, 0.690 at 00:09 and 0.411 at 00:10, while the earlier ad instance (39b91122-9863-40da-948e-904cce302614) stayed at 0.22-0.41.

ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config (data key demo.flagd.json) contains adManualGc with "defaultVariant": "on", "state": "ENABLED", description "Triggers full manual garbage collections in the ad service", variants {off:false,on:true}; adFailure has "defaultVariant": "off" and adHighCpu has "defaultVariant": "off". adManualGc is the only ad-related fault switch that is not off.

No other service shows a sustained error signal in 23:50-00:16Z (2-minute rate): accounting, ad and payment 0 throughout; recommendation 0.011/s at one sample; fraud-detection 0.0117/s at 00:06; only frontend (up to 3.57/s) and frontend-proxy (up to 1.77/s) are nonzero over multiple samples.
The ad Service's endpoints currently contain one address, the pod ad-d89765fb5-whfnz (100.96.1.122) port tcp-service 8080, consistent with the single-replica ad Deployment.

Sampled frontend spans from 2026-11-17T23:57:24Z show grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds completing with rpc.grpc.status_code "0" and no error detail, i.e. the ad dependency was answering successfully immediately before the 23:59:42Z rollout.
Pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-vzsmb has restartCount 1 with last termination reason OOMKilled, exitCode 137, finishedAt 2026-11-17T23:32:37Z, i.e. it restarted before the ad rollout at 23:59:42Z.

The enabled adManualGc switch ("Triggers full manual garbage collections in the ad service") is the injected fault behind this incident: in the freshly restarted ad pod it kept the JVM at 0.98-0.99 of its 50m CPU quota with ~10 fully throttled CFS periods/s and repeated Eden-space turnover, ad served no GetAds spans from 00:02 to 00:09, and frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client spans failed, producing GET /api/data errors and the RequestErrorRate alert.

Alternative mechanism: the configuration-only rollout of Deployment ad at 23:59:42Z replaced the only ad replica, and the new JVM was CPU-starved by the pod's 50m limit (container Started 23:59:44, first log line 00:03:55, CFS throttled on essentially every 100ms period until 00:07, serving resumed ~00:08-00:09), so frontend's GetAds calls failed for ~8 minutes purely because of restart plus CPU limitation rather than any flag value.

Against a persistent per-request GC effect: the previous ad pod ad-554b849958-gcmfq ran the same workload with the same flagd-config present at 0.0038-0.0080 cores and 0.22-0.41 JVM CPU ratio, and the restarted pod's CPU fell back to 0.0096 cores at 00:10 and 0.0081 at 00:11 with JVM ratio 0.41-0.44 while adManualGc still reads "on" and GetAds spans had resumed at 0.56-0.76/s; the saturation is confined to the startup interval, which favours the startup/CPU-limit explanation.

Rejected: the adFailure or adHighCpu fault switches. Both are "defaultVariant": "off" in flagd-config, so neither fault was in effect, and ad's CPU saturation therefore cannot be attributed to the adHighCpu switch.

Rejected: frontend's other gRPC dependencies caused the errors. During the burst the frontend error series for grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart and POST /api/checkout were all 0, and only the AdService/GetAds client operation carried the same error rate as GET /api/data.

Rejected: the ad service returned its own errors. ad's error-tagged span series were 0 throughout the burst (the only ad error samples were flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream at 0.0037/s in 23:55-23:58Z on the pre-restart pod), so the failure appeared as ad not serving requests, not as ad-reported errors.

Rejected as this cause: the fraud-detection container's OOMKilled restart at 23:32:37Z. It precedes the ad rollout by ~27 minutes, fraud-detection's own error rate stayed at 0 except one 0.0117/s sample at 00:06, and frontend's error burst begins at 00:01 with the ad rollout.

Treat ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config as the object to review first: confirm in the flag provider/UI when adManualGc was switched to "on" and whether it should be on, and correlate that with the ad restart at 2026-11-17T23:59:42Z.

Independent of the flag question, the ad Deployment has 1 replica, no probes and a 50m CPU limit, which let a single rollout remove the only ad backend and made the replacement JVM take ~8 minutes to serve; consider more replicas, a startup/readiness probe and a less restrictive CPU limit so a restart does not exhaust the request budget.

gaps: Who or what applied kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T23:59:42Z to Deployment ad is unknown; the change_history integration is not available in this Run, so the restart trigger could not be identified.

No trace-level error detail exists for the failure interval: traces_search for frontend returned nothing after 2026-11-17T23:57:24Z (the sampled result ended at 23:57:27Z) and traces_search_by_tags on grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds for 00:01-00:06Z returned no traces, so the gRPC status code of the failed frontend->ad calls (e.g. UNAVAILABLE vs DEADLINE_EXCEEDED) is unknown.

Whether the declared adManualGc fault (full manual garbage collections in ad) actually executed could not be confirmed: no JVM GC-count metric is among the available series, and only jvm_cpu_recent_utilization_ratio, jvm_memory_used_bytes and jvm_memory_used_after_last_gc_bytes were available.

When the adManualGc value in ConfigMap flagd-config was changed is unknown - only its current data and resourceVersion 1600726 are visible; the ad pod's flagd EventStream error samples at 23:55-23:58Z hint at a flag push before the restart but do not prove it.

Image digest equality between the deleted pod ad-554b849958-gcmfq and the new pod cannot be verified: kube_pod_container_info has no series in this Prometheus for namespace otel-demo, so 'unchanged image' rests on the Deployment spec (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad) rather than on image_id.

The RequestErrorRate alerting rule could not be read (list_prometheus_rules for rule_name RequestErrorRate returned no_data), so the exact expression behind the reported current value 2.355555555555555 is unknown.

gRPC status/duration detail for frontend->ad calls is unavailable: rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count has no series in this target, so the frontend->ad outcome could only be inferred from traces_span_metrics status_code.
ad's application log contains only the single startup line for the whole window, so the startup sequence between 23:59:44Z and 00:10Z (flagd connection, port binding, readiness) is unknown.
The fraud-detection OOMKilled restart (exit 137, 23:32:37Z) has no identified trigger and was not tied to any user-facing error; it is left unattributed rather than attributed to this incident.
next_steps: Query the change/audit history (not integrated here) for who ran a rollout restart on Deployment ad at 2026-11-17T23:59:42Z and for any change to the demo.flagd.json flags around 23:55-23:59Z.
Check the flagd UI/provider audit (flagd-ui container of pod flagd-7b48fd4796-slcsz) for when adManualGc became "on" and whether ad CPU/GC behaviour changed with it.
Once Jaeger has spans for 00:00-00:10Z, inspect the frontend grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error spans to determine whether the failures were connection-refused/UNAVAILABLE or deadline-based.

Review whether the 50m CPU limit on the ad container is appropriate for JVM startup, and whether a startup/readiness probe and a second replica should be added so a configuration-only rollout cannot take out the only ad backend.
